title: Actual sparse trace equals actual physical input sum

spec.name: M6.ActualTransfer.boundary_trace_inputs
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → ∀ P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N), M6.ActualTransfer.boundaryTrace N a b P = ∑ h : M6.Transfer.Input N, M6.Character.pinnedMonomial P (M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.boundary N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b) h))
queries: finite product sum equivalence cyclic convolution
spec.guidance: Unfold actual trace, use scalar_trace_polynomial with boundary_edge_bounds for actual pin factors. Then array_trace_inputs and sum_congr using boundary_input_product with le_max_left/right and span<N. Do not replace actual sparse evaluator. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ActualTransfer.character_trace_inputs
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → ∀ P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N), M6.ActualTransfer.characterTrace N a b P = ∑ h : M6.Transfer.Input N, (∏ q : Fin (2*N), M6.Character.pinnedCharacterFactor P q (M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.J N (M6.Physical.boundary N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b) h)) q))
queries: finite product sum equivalence cyclic convolution
spec.guidance: Unfold actual trace, use scalar_trace_polynomial with character_edge_bounds for actual pin factors. Then array_trace_inputs and sum_congr using character_input_product with le_max_left/right and span<N. Do not replace actual sparse evaluator. Return tactic lines without leading by.
